## Installing

**Already have Snowball?** Do nothing. Snowball updates itself: the new version
downloads in the background and applies when you next restart the launcher. You
can check under **Settings → Updates**.

**New to Snowball?** Download `SnowballClient-X.Y.Z-setup.exe` below and run it.
It installs for the current user, so it does not ask for administrator rights.

**Prefer not to install?** `SnowballClient-X.Y.Z-portable.exe` runs from
anywhere. It does not update itself — come back here for new versions.

Windows may warn that the publisher is unverified. That warning is accurate:
Snowball is not code-signed yet. Check the SHA-256 of your download against
`SHA256SUMS.txt` below if you want to confirm you have the real file. Never
disable SmartScreen or your antivirus to run it.

## Checksums
